tei:div.tei:p: ༈ karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum/ ta/

1 rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa bzhugs/ 2 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon rtogs bzhugs/ 3 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gi cho ga bzhugs/ 4 shrī ma hā ma ya'i mngon rtogs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 5 dpal pad ma rgyal po'i rgyud kyi bsdus don bzhugs/ 6 rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs bzhugs/ 7 spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas sgrib pa sbyong ba bzhugs/ 8 mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i snying po'i mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs/ 9 dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang gi cho ga bzhugs/ 10 shes rab snang ba'i sgrub thabs phag mo dkar mo bzhugs/ 11 dpal lū hi pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi bsdus don bzhugs/
